source: provisional, pendiente de Aguado: risk cutoffs are placeholders, not a clinical validation; global-risk cutoffs for triage levels must be decided with clinical judgement (#53)

rules.source: provisional, pendiente de Aguado: sphincter dysfunction is a textbook cauda equina warning sign; any report escalates at once
provisional, pendiente de Aguado: saddle anaesthesia is a textbook cauda equina warning sign; any report escalates at once
provisional, pendiente de Aguado: motor deficit suggests significant nerve root or cord compromise; treated like the cauda equina signs
provisional, pendiente de Aguado: fever with back pain can indicate spinal infection; treated as an emergency pending clinical review
provisional, pendiente de Aguado: a trauma event with back symptoms may imply fracture or injury; priority review, urgency level to be set by Aguado
provisional, pendiente de Aguado: radicular pain suggests nerve root irritation; flagged for priority medical review without forcing red
provisional, pendiente de Aguado: sensory symptoms suggest nerve involvement; flagged for priority medical review without forcing red
provisional, pendiente de Aguado: non-mechanical night pain is a conventional red flag for serious pathology; flagged for priority review
provisional, pendiente de Aguado: a pain NRS of 7 or more on the 0-10 scale is the usual convention for severe pain; cutoff to be confirmed
